title: What the House Did Unasked
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (study 85): seventeen written instructions of the house that a script can decide from Git, read against the full public history of the ecology's four repositories; one lane per instruction and practice and one cell per day, each opening to that day's files and commits with links; a table by practice; the readings of a line and a word side by side; the first week of each rule against the time after; the same record beside the Atelier's record side of the seven public instruments; predictions fixed before the count; drawn by script with no library; numbers from analyse85.py, recounted by verify85.mjs
embodies: From 12 July to 19 November 2026 seventeen written instructions that a script can decide from Git bound 8,098 files and commits in the four public repositories of the house (field-research, ulysses, studio, research-ecology). By the codebook's reading 171 broke one, all of them a limit on length (171 of 1,402 items under a limit, 12.2 %); none of 6,654 items under a prohibition (no AI-product credit, no foreign script, no rewritten process entry, no practice editing a line file, no signature naming a product or another person) and none of 42 under a duty broke one. Only 39 break a limit in every reading: lines counted as lines of the file give 60 breaches, counted as paragraphs and items 10; the Field's digest is over 2,500 words in 89 of 159 versions when any letter counts and in 7 by the Field's own counter, which reads A to Z only. 21 of the 39 fall under the limits set on 13 November (journal entries, commit subjects, a bulletin). Rules gave way most in their first week: 37 breaches in 716 items (5.2 %) against 99 in 7,045 after (1.4 %). Every deed counted is its own record in Git, checkable without any model. Predictions: P132 failed (18 of 48 pairs record a breach), P133 held, P134 failed.
